# RigidBody

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/components/rigid_body.h`](../../../src/logic/components/rigid_body.h) · Scene / prefab name: `RigidBody` · Described in `data/core.json`

A Jolt body next to a Transform: static, dynamic (simulated) or kinematic (follows its Transform)

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `motion` | `RigidBody::Motion` | Static, Dynamic (default), Kinematic; JSON static / dynamic / kinematic |
| `shape` | `RigidBody::Shape` | Box (default), Sphere, Capsule; JSON box / sphere / capsule |
| `half_extent` | `glm::vec3` | box half sizes (0.5); sphere radius x; capsule radius x and cylinder half height y (local Y) |
| `offset` | `glm::vec3` | shape centre relative to the Transform position, local space (0) |
| `friction` | `float` | 0.6 |
| `restitution` | `float` | 0.1 |
| `angular_damping` | `float` | 0.05 (Jolt's default) |
| `mass` | `float` | kg, inertia scaled to it; 0: Jolt's density of 1000 kg/m3 |
| `lock_rotation` | `bool` | dynamic only: translations only (a player's body) |
| `initial_velocity` | `glm::vec3` | dynamic only, m/s at creation |
| `initial_angular_velocity` | `glm::vec3` | dynamic only, rad/s at creation |
| `body` | `uint32_t` | JPH::BodyID (index and sequence), 0xffffffff until RigidBodySys creates it; created() |

## Notes

RigidBodySys makes the body on its next tick and removes it when the component or entity goes (on_destroy). Removed by RigidBodySys when the body cannot be made. Body user data = entity + 1 (bodyEntity).

## Side effects of those systems

- **[BodyDrives](../systems/BodyDrives.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<BodyDrive>` and `on_destroy<RigidBody>` in preinit, disconnects them in finish.
  - Creates a `SixDOFConstraint` (all axes free, motors in velocity mode) per ready drive, `AddConstraint`; `RemoveConstraint` when the drive, its body or its anchor goes, the anchor or `rotate` changes, or in finish.
  - Every physics step: force / torque limits and target velocities of the motors, `ActivateBody` of the body and its anchor.
- **[BoxDrop](../systems/BoxDrop.md)**
  - Creates count entities in init.
- **[BoxRing](../systems/BoxRing.md)**
  - 12 dynamic boxes with Jolt bodies (made by RigidBodySys) 4 m + size above the ground, rotated about (1, 1, 0).
- **[BoxThrower](../systems/BoxThrower.md)**
  - A new entity with a dynamic Jolt body per click, never destroyed; colours cycle from a function-static counter.
- **[DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md)**
  - One ImGui window "Dynamical" (needs UI before it).
  - Changing the soil or grass height-map parameters makes SoilMaps / GrassPass bake their per-chunk maps again (they watch RenderSettings).
  - Creates torch entities and dynamic boxes (Jolt bodies through RigidBodySys) on button presses; destroys every PointLight entity on "No torches".
- **[DesktopRoller](../systems/DesktopRoller.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[Grab](../systems/Grab.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<RigidBody>` in preinit (disconnected in finish): the grips of a destroyed hand or object are taken off without a throw.
  - At each physics step: `CollideShape` of the hand's shape (max separation `touch`), `FixedConstraint` (priority 1000, 40 velocity / 8 position steps) added at the deepest contact; removed on release, teleport, finish.
  - On a throw: `SetLinearAndAngularVelocity` of the released body.
  - Sets and clears collision groups of grabbed bodies.
- **[Hold](../systems/Hold.md)**
  - Narrow phase ray cast of `reach` along the view on a press of interact.
  - Sets the collision group of the held body; clears it and, on a throw, sets its linear velocity when it is dropped.
  - Adds and removes BodyDrive components (BodyDrives makes the constraint).
- **[ModelLineup](../systems/ModelLineup.md)**
  - Lists ./resources/models with std::filesystem (errors ignored) and loads each .gltf / .glb: files read, GPU buffers uploaded by the model loader.
  - One dynamic Jolt body per model (RigidBodySys).
- **[Mountables](../systems/Mountables.md)**
  - Connects `on_destroy<Mountable>` in preinit (disconnected in finish).
  - Reads the species' skin geometry (`resources/animals/species/<id>.bin`) once per species, runs `analyseGait` on its walk clip.
  - Creates a collider entity per Mountable within `range` of a Rider (or ridden) and destroys it when none is.
  - Logs once per species: `Mountables : <id>, saddle <h> m up on <joint>, walks <v> m/s, runs <v> m/s` (info), or a warning when the geometry cannot be read.
- **[Mounting](../systems/Mounting.md)**
  - `CollideShape` of the player's capsule, at its place and 0.6 m lower, with max separation `reach`, on a press of jump when not riding.
  - Sets the collision group of the ridden animal's collider; clears it 0.6 s after getting off.
  - On a jump off: `SetLinearVelocity` of the player (the saddle's velocity plus `hop` m/s to the animal's left and 1 m/s up).
- **[Physics](../systems/Physics.md)**
  - Steps the host's Jolt PhysicsSystem on its job system threads.
  - Destroys entities whose interpolated position is under -1000 m.
  - Runs the FixedSteps functions of other systems inside its tick.
  - Profiler zones Physics step, Fixed steps before, Jolt update, Fixed steps after; plots Physics steps, Active bodies.
- **[PhysicsStep](../systems/PhysicsStep.md)**
  - Steps the world's Jolt PhysicsSystem (single threaded with threads 1).
- **[PlayerLegs](../systems/PlayerLegs.md)**
  - At each 60 Hz physics step (FixedSteps.before): a narrow phase ray cast per player, `AddForce` of the stand, walk and jump forces, `ActivateBody`.
  - Sets the collision group of the player's body once (`SetCollisionGroup`).
- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
- **[Probe](../systems/service-Game.md)**
  - Writes the probe CSV file, flushed after every sample.
- **[RayScene](../systems/service-RayScene.md)**
  - Builds and refits acceleration structures in the frame's compute command buffer; allocates their buffers, scratch, geometry table and instance buffers.
  - Writes Context::tlas, ray_geometries and ray_textures, which every view set gets.
  - Connects onChunkGone to on_destroy<ChunkTriangles>; the destructor disconnects it and waits for the device.
- **[RiderSeat](../systems/RiderSeat.md)**
  - At each physics step: `AddForce` on the rider's body ((pull - gravity) x mass) and `ActivateBody`.
- **[RigidBody](../systems/RigidBody.md)**
  - Creates, adds, removes and destroys Jolt bodies; OptimizeBroadPhase after static geometry is added.
  - Connects on_destroy<RigidBody>, on_destroy<Ground>, on_destroy<HeightField> (disconnected in finish and the destructor).
  - Log warnings on invalid shapes, invalid height fields and when Jolt is out of bodies.
- **[SphereControl](../systems/SphereControl.md)**
  - Adds a torque to the sphere's Jolt body every tick the held torque is not zero.
  - At a reset teleports the Jolt body and builds the marching cubes colliders around the spawn point synchronously.
  - Logs an error in init when the world does not hold exactly one SphereAgent + Transform + RigidBody entity.
- **[SphereObserve](../systems/SphereObserve.md)**
  - Three downward ray casts against the world's static bodies per window.
  - At a trainer RESET, teleports the Jolt body and builds the spawn column's colliders.
- **[SphereTask](../systems/SphereTask.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[SphereView](../systems/SphereView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Sphere roller"; collapses "Dynamical", "Worlds" and "Frame time" on first use.
  - Five host entities for the markers, destroyed in finish.
- **[TerrainColliders](../systems/TerrainColliders.md)**
  - Creates and destroys static Jolt MeshShape bodies in sorted cell order (deterministic).
  - Taskflow for_each (waited) over new required cells and silent_async prefetch jobs; zone Build collider cell.
  - Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin in preinit (throws when missing).
  - Log warning 'Terrain collider : ...' when Jolt refuses a mesh.
- **[VRBody](../systems/VRBody.md)**
  - Teleports the player's Jolt body by the head's motion each frame (`BodyInterface::SetPosition`, activated).
- **[VRControl](../systems/VRControl.md)**
  - Hands are only made when VRInput is enabled and box.gltf loads; the RigidBody system gives them kinematic Jolt bodies that push dynamic bodies around.
  - Each press of the right trigger spawns a box 20 cm ahead of the controller with 1.5x the hand's velocity (a new entity and Jolt body per press, never destroyed).
- **[VRHands](../systems/VRHands.md)**
  - At each physics step: `SetPositionAndRotation` + `SetLinearAndAngularVelocity` of a hand more than `failsafe` from its target; `AddForce` of its share (by mass) of the legs' force.
  - Sets the collision group of each hand body once.
- **[VRRoller](../systems/VRRoller.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[World](../systems/service-Game.md)**
  - Creates the template's entities in World::init through the registered component emplacers.
  - One Jolt job system per world (single threaded with threads 1); Worlds::step runs worlds in parallel on an executor.
- **[WorldTerrain](../systems/WorldTerrain.md)**
  - Creates and destroys static Jolt MeshShape bodies in the world's PhysicsWorld, in sorted cell order.
  - CPU marching cubes and FastNoise2 sampling on the world's thread.
  - Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin in preinit; log warning on a refused mesh.
- **[WorldView](../systems/WorldView.md)**
  - Uploads generated capsule meshes to the GPU through ModelManager::add (Transfer), once per size.
  - Creates and destroys host entities as bodies appear and go; destroys all of them in finish.
